question: Calculate the percentage of the cards availabe in Chinese Simplified.
evidence: Chinese Simplified' is the language; percentage = Divide(Sum(id where language = 'Chinese Simplified'), Count(id)) *100
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid

d.request: What percentage of cards are available in Chinese Simplified (computed as the sum of ids where language = 'Chinese Simplified' divided by the count of ids, times 100), while also keeping cards that have no matching foreign_data record?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN c.id ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.id) FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid

c.request:
Calculate the percentage of the cards availabe in Chinese Simplified.
Evidence: Chinese Simplified' is the language; percentage = Divide(Sum(id where language = 'Chinese Simplified'), Count(id)) *100
Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
c.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN f.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(c.id) AS percentage FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid

b.request: Calculate the percentage of all cards (including those with no foreign_data record) whose foreign_data language is 'Chinese Simplified', computed as the share of cards that have a Chinese Simplified entry out of the total card count, using a left join from cards to foreign_data.
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN c.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS percentage FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
